'''Trall Venkorr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he was an escaped convict wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for assault and serial homicide. He was last seen in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and his wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trall Venkorr appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
